findings.text: the config resolution passes no project, so the project layer that dispatch reads at reckon/crew/runs.py:2229 and reckon/crew/recovery.py:466 is unread while each row's alias is frozen at dispatch from the project-aware config through _stamp_agent_display at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1689, and the docstring at reckon/crew/ticker.py:643-645 claims all four dispatch layers are read; logs/receipt-project-layer.log measures the divergence directly, a project layer declaring project-alias-v1 resolving to ('project-alias-v1',) through resolve(project_path=...) while declared_model_aliases() returns () and the width falls back to the ten-column default, and project is in scope at the construction site reckon/cli.py:2279.

the expected cell start is derived from ticker_module.MODEL, the ten-column default, while the rendered width now comes from the resolved config, so the assertion holds only where the flight config declares no alias and not in the configuration the change exists to serve — evidenced by this file's own log for this finding at tests/test_crew_ticker.py:784 failing in logs/receipt-ambient-config.log under a config declaring dsv4.1-flash.

the cut and the column arithmetic are computed from ticker_module.MODEL rather than grid.model_width, the width the grid being rendered with actually uses; the same shape appears at tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:710 and tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:716, and logs/receipt-layout-ambient.log measures 10 failures in this file under a declaring config, 1 of them pre-existing, so 9 are config-dependent and this test is one.

the pre-existing _spend_columns prefix is built from ticker_module.MODEL, which the change makes reachable: while the model cell was always MODEL wide the prefix was correct, and a config-declared alias now shifts the six tests that read their columns from it, as logs/receipt-layout-ambient.log shows.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the two fenced ticker test files with added failures 0 against the base revision and a recorded red control; the manifest states base "1 failed, 91 passed" and head "1 failed, 92 passed", logs/baseline.log and logs/after.log each open with their own revision header and command, and re-running that gate in the reviewed tree at 2f8d9045 reproduces "1 failed, 92 passed" with the single failure being the pre-existing test_the_action_set_is_one_set_with_three_readers.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal asks that the follower row's model cell be sized from the longest alias the resolved flight config declares and that an unconfigured model id be cut with an ellipsis; reckon/crew/ticker.py:831 sets Ticker.model_width from model_cell_width(declared_model_aliases()) and the render at reckon/crew/ticker.py:947 elides the model cell, a declaring host layer drives the width to 12 in logs/receipt-config-liveness.log, but the resolution at reckon/crew/ticker.py:658 passes no project, so the project layer the wording implies is not read.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; it records status complete, both counts with their logs, the declared control repeated verbatim on the red log's first line with the module restored afterwards and its sha1 checked against the pre-control backup, and the one failure present at the base revision recorded as a follow-on rather than repaired.

justifications.durability: the new test at tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:943 pins grid.model_width and fails under the declared mutation, but the three reversed assertions compute the grid from ticker_module.MODEL rather than the width the grid renders with, and logs/receipt-layout-ambient.log measures 9 config-dependent failures in that file alone.

justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the seven paths in git diff --name-status 12155ff8..2f8d9045 lies inside the manifest's declared write paths, with the model_aliases parameter at reckon/crew/ticker.py:823 the only surface no caller in the tree reaches.
